Promotion
We are delighted that you would like to do a doctorate at the School of Science.
The introduction of Promovendus took place in September 2018. This is used to initiate all steps (e.g. acceptance as a doctoral student/opening of the doctoral procedure).
Before contacting us via email or personally, please use the information, descriptions, FAQs and regulations on the page of the School of Science: Doctorate at the School of Science
Note 1: The opening of doctoral and habilitation procedures (submission) is only possible by prior appointment.
Note 2: For all doctoral matters please use the e-mail address . We will get back to you as soon as possible.
